parts.note_add: Joins the front harness at X-03, a 22-cavity (3+5+3 per row) connector, 21 wires, one unused (S-001 p30); per the routing sheet X-03 is on the left side behind the door (S-001 p15, confirm). S-001 shows the rear defroster feed (LG, p24) and the back-up lamp output (RW, p22) passing through it. Mazda no longer supplies it; only used harnesses are available.

On a car without a rear wiper this is the defroster grid's ground return: grid G-25 terminal (B) to connector X-18 (two 1-pin connectors, B wire) to ground X-15. The feed (LG) comes through the rear harness at X-03 (S-001 p24, p30). With a rear wiper the grid ground passes through D-07 instead.

Used only with the rear wiper, at the connector to the rear wiper (D-07, wires B, LB, BG, L per S-001 section D). The grid ground shares that connector ('D-07 or X-18', S-001 p24). If the car has no rear wiper, these terminals are not fitted.

Joins the front harness at X-01, a 22-cavity connector with 20 wires (S-001 p30). Four wires change colour across it (front side / engine side): BLb/Lg, YR/BG, BR/Br, BrR/LgY. The 81-82 harness has a white tag with an FA01/FA02-style number (rx7club); Mazda no longer supplies it.

This is S-001's A-02: a 0.5 sq fusible link, printed green (G). A ring terminal sits on the starting motor's battery terminal, held by lock washer 8872-18-056 and a nut (S-005 fig 6701A-1). It feeds the LW wire through X-10 to the hot start relay (A-03) and the No.1 water temp switch (S-001 p10). The identification is by matching drawings; confirm on the car. With the Weber conversion the hot-start circuit may be dead.

The A/T transmission harness joins at X-10, a 6-pin connector (BW GY BR / LW RW BY), and at X-17, two 1-pin connectors (BL, BY) (S-001 p30). It carries the inhibitor switch's start interlock (BY in, BW out to the starter), the back-up lamp circuit (GY in, RW out) and the LW hot-start feed.

This is S-001's B-09 short connector, on top of the engine (S-001 p15). The plug joins wire GB (emission control unit terminal V, via X-01) to wire BY (the starter ST signal, which also reaches unit terminal H) (S-001 p12). What the unit does with that input is not stated in S-001; confirm.

This is S-001's 'inpane' harness. It meets the front harness at X-02 (22 pins, all used) and X-12 (10-pin plus a 2-pin RL/GL), and meets the GSL parking brake harness at X-11 (S-001 p30). The 81-83 dash harness FA01-67-030C still turns up used; Mazda no longer supplies it.
